summary: Private raft with five occupants flipped in the runoff-swollen Eagle River near EagleVail; four occupants swam ashore while a fifth rafter was reported missing; a multi-agency river search found the missing rafter floating near the Eaglebend Apartments in Avon, CPR was started immediately and the victim was transported to a hospital where resuscitation was unsuccessful.
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle River Fire Protection District; Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Avon Police Department; Eagle County Paramedic Services; Vail Public Safety Communications Center
notes: Resolved the run-550 pending 2021/2023 ECSO water-fatality lead set; the standing-lead date (2021-06-06) was wrong — the Real Vail article is dated Thursday 2019-06-06 and names VMRG among responding agencies.
